title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: LPG FITTINGS (135 affected)
summary: THE LPG IRON MANIFOLD SYSTEM WAS NOT BONDED TO THE CHASSIS GROUND. THIS CAN CREATE THE POTENTIAL FOR ELECTRICAL ARCING BETWEEN THE CHASSIS FRAME AND THE LPG IRON MANIFOLD SYSTEM.

title: WALTCO TRUCK EQUIPMENT CO: STRUCTURE:TAILGATE ASSEMBLY (54 affected)
summary: THE LIFTGATE PULLEY ASSEMBLY CAN CONTACT A SUPPORT GUSSET IN ITS NORMAL MOVEMENT AND THIS INTERFERENCE MAY STRESS THE CYLINDER ROD, CAUSING A FATIGUE FAILURE AT THE ROD PIN HOLE.

title: GEORGIE BOY MFG., LLC: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:AUXILLIARY GENERATOR (24 affected)
summary: THE HEAT DUCT FROM THE FURNACE TO THE FRESH WATER TANK COMPARTMENT PENETRATES THE GENERATOR COMPARTMENT. THIS RESULTS IN EXHAUST FUMES ENTERING THE LIVING AREA.

title: KYB CORP. OF AMERICA: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER (5,740 affected)
summary: THE SHOCK ABSORBER ATTACHMENT BRACKET TO THE SWAY LINK BAR HAS REINFORCEMENT WELDS THAT CAN FAIL DUE TO AN ASSEMBLY PROBLEM. THE ATTACHMENT BRACKET CAN BREAK AWAY FROM THE SHOCK ABSORBER AND REMAIN ATTACHED TO THE SWAY LINK BAR, AND CAN THEN FALL INTO AND DAMAGE OR PUNCTURE THE PROXIMAL TIRE.

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES (1,230 affected)
summary: THE TIRES FAILED THE MANUFACTURER'S REQUIREMENTS FOR EXTENDED HIGH SPEED PERFORMANCE  (TIRES COMPLY WITH FMVSS 109,"NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES").

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (2,000 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE ABS EQUIPPED VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH AN UNDERSIZED BRAKE RETURN CHECK VALVE. IN INCIDENTS WHERE HARD BRAKE PEDAL EFFORT IS APPLIED ON LOW FRICTION ROAD SURFACES, LIKE RAIN COVERED STREETS, THE VALVES MAY FAIL, CAUSING THE ABS TO BECOME INOPERATIVE. THIS CREATES EXCESS BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL AND MAY CAUSE THE ABS WARNING LIGHT TO COME ON.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH (100,000 affected)
summary: SALT CORROSION PRODUCTS BETWEEN THE STARTER SOLENOID WIRE AND THE ADJACENT BATTERY FEED IN THE BULKHEAD CONNECTOR MAY SHORT THESE CONNECTIONS, CAUSING THE CIRCUIT TO BYPASS THE IGNITION KEY CONTROL OF THE STARTER MOTOR SOLENOID. THE CAR CAN START WITHOUT THE STARTER SEQUENCE BEING INITIATED BY THE IGNITION  KEY IN THE IGNITION LOCK.

title: ROCKWOOD INCORPORATED: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (155 affected)
summary: THE MOUNTING BRACKET FOR THE REAR TRAILER HITCH MAY BREAK BECAUSE IT  DOES NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO WITHSTAND THE LOADS OF AN ATTACHED TRAILER.

title: ROVER GROUP, LIMITED: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES (463 affected)
summary: THE POWER WINDOW AND SUNROOF LATCH SWITCHES REMAIN IN AN OPERATIONAL MODE WHEN THE PRESSURE IS REMOVED, CAUSING THE WINDOW OR SUNROOF TO CONTINUE TO CLOSE OR OPEN.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (1,932 affected)
summary: A WELD IN THE DOOR LOCK ASSEMBLY USED ON REAR AND/OR SIDE EMERGENCY DOORS CAN BE OVERSTRESSED AND BREAK. WHEN THIS OCCURS, A CLOSED DOOR CANNOT BE OPENED, OR IF OPEN IT CANNOT BE LATCHED.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (173 affected)
summary: THE FRONT BRAKE AIR LINES ARE INCORRECTLY ROUTED THROUGH THE PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE AT THE AUXILIARY WET TANK. THIS RESULTS IN LACK OF AIR PRESSURE TO THE FRONT BRAKES WHEN THE AIR PRESSURE IN THE AUXILIARY WET TANK DROPS BELOW 65 P.S.I., RESULTING IN INOPERABLE FRONT BRAKES.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: WHEEL CHAIR PASSIVE STEP LIFT (248 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: DIESEL POWERED, RUBBER TIRE STREET CARS, 24,OOO LBS. GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT EQUIPPED WITH A MOBILE-TECH, MODEL 3213,  WHEEL CHAIR STEP LIFT.  THE PASSIVE STEP LIFT'S BARRIER WHICH KEEPS A WHEEL CHAIR AND ITS OCCUPANT FROM ROLLING OFF THE LIFT PAD FAILS WHEN HIT BY A POWERED WHEEL CHAIR.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC (10,146 affected)
summary: THE FUEL FEED AND RETURN LINES TO THE ENGINE FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM WERE NOT FULLY ASSEMBLED AND LOCKED. THE LINES CAN WORK LOOSE, CAUSING A FUEL LEAK IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.

title: Ford Motor Company: POWER TRAIN:TRANSFER CASE (4-WHEEL DRIVE) (1,389 affected)
summary: THE TRANSFER CASES HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH THE WRONG ELECTRIC SHIFT MOTOR. THE TRANSFER CASES CAN SLIP OUT OF THE 4 X 4 HIGH GEAR POSITION DURING COASTING IN FORWARD GEARS OR WITH POWER APPLIED IN REVERSE GEAR.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR (85 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR MAY FAIL WHEN LEFT ON DURING PERIODS WHEN THE WINDSHIELD HAS DRIED AND FRICTION ON THE WIPER BLADES INCREASES.

title: APEX: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG (11,448 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE FLUID DOES NOT MEET THE VISCOSITY, EVAPORATION, AND EFFECT ON RUBBER COMPONENTS REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213, "MOTOR VEHICLE BRAKE FLUIDS."

title: FBS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (313,831 affected)
summary: THE CHILD SAFETY SEATS DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS." THE PADDING BEHIND THE HEAD OF THE SEAT OCCUPANT DOES NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT COMPRESSION DEFLECTION RESISTANCE.

title: TRADEWINDS CONVERSIONS: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (200 affected)
summary: THE LATCHING OR LOCKING PIN ON THE MID-SEATING PEDESTAL DOES NOT CONSISTENTLY MEET THE MINIMUM LOAD TEST, AND DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS."

title: Volvo Trucks North America: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (1,075 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY CAN GET CAUGHT IN THE SEAT SUSPENSION MECHANISM. THE MOVEMENT OF THE AIR SUSPENSION SEAT COULD CAUSE THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE TETHER CABLE TO FRAY .

title: Skyline Corporation: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:STOVE (63 affected)
summary: THE REFRIGERATOR INSTALLED IN THE TRAILER CAN OVERHEAT BECAUSE THE REFRIGERATOR BAFFLE AND FLUE VENT ARE NOT PROPERLY ALIGNED. HEAT FROM THE COMPRESSOR WILL NOT VENT PROPERLY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM (193 affected)
summary: THE PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE WAS OMITTED IN THE AIR TANK. THE AIR TANK IS THE RESERVOIR FOR THE AIR SUSPENSION AND IS NOT BRAKE RELATED. WITHOUT THE PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE, THERE IS NO BACK-UP SYSTEM TO LIMIT AIR PRESSURE IN THE AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM.

title: AUTOMATIC EQUIP. MFG. CO.: WHEELS:MULTIPLE:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (2,149 affected)
summary: THE CAR DOLLY WHEELS WERE INSTALLED WITH 90 DEGREE CONE LUG NUTS INSTEAD OF 60 DEGREE CONE LUG NUTS. THE LUG NUTS DO NOT SEAT PROPERLY IN THE WHEEL HOLES AND CAN BECOME LOOSE.

title: General Motors, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (14,459 affected)
summary: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE TERMINAL AT THE STARTER SOLENOID MAY BE FORMED INCORRECTLY. INCORRECTLY FORMED TERMINALS CAN CONTACT THE STARTER SOLENOID HOUSING AND CAUSE AN ELECTRIC SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (128,000 affected)
summary: DUE TO HEAT EFFECTS, THE THROTTLE BUSHING LOCATED ON THE ACCELERATOR CONTROL CABLE, CAN FATIGUE AND BREAK, CAUSING THE THROTTLE LINKAGE TO SEPARATE.
